name: Module 3: capsule wash
source: SPC-NAR (Leonaviciene & Mazutis, NAR 2023): capsule washes at 2000 g, 2 min, replaced here by a mesh trap with back-flush; CapSeq (Baronas et al., Science 2026): repeated washes between steps. Timings from operator/flow_calc.py. GENERATED by cad/generators/m3_wash.py.
description: Capsule wash on the Module 3 chip: load, three washes down through the mesh to waste, back-flush to resuspend, release. 20 uL/min keeps the predicted pressure on the capsule bed at 1.00 kPa (limit 3.50 kPa). Volumes are placeholders.

steps.note: Load 10,000 capsules through the top inlet; they settle in a single layer on the mesh.
Wash three times: buffer flows down through the mesh to waste while the capsules stay on top.
Back-flush from below to lift the capsules off the mesh and resuspend them.
Flush the washed capsules out through the release outlet.
